Poseidon / Polyphemus / eye injury / family relation / blocked homecoming
principles: Pictiq translates semantic and practical function, not source-language surface form.
Pictiq preserves distinctions required for intended meaning or action, not distinctions merely because a source language lexicalizes or grammaticalizes them.
Pictiq does not encode gender by default.
Communication structure can perform a speech act without a lexical tile naming that speech act.
The meaning of a Pictiq composition may emerge from the semantic frame of the whole group.
